title: Understand Slope as Rate of Change Review Test
description: Interpret slope as a constant rate of change in tables, graphs, equations, and contexts.

questions.questionText: A constant-rate situation changes by 2 miles while x changes by 4 hours. What is the rate of change?
questions.explanation: Rate of change is output change divided by input change. It is the same idea as slope.
